name: GLightbox
description: Responsive touch-friendly lightbox powered by GLightbox with keyboard navigation, zoom, and rich captions.
author: Folder Gallery

loop.label: Loop slides
loop.description: Wrap around from the last image back to the first.

zoomable.label: Enable zoom
zoomable.description: Allow zooming in on full-size images.

draggable.label: Touch & mouse drag
draggable.description: Allow swiping or dragging between images.

closeOnOutsideClick.label: Close on backdrop click
closeOnOutsideClick.description: Close the lightbox when clicking outside the image.

openEffect.label: Open / close animation
openEffect.description: Transition effect when opening and closing the modal.

slideEffect.label: Slide transition
slideEffect.description: Animation style when moving between images.

descPosition.label: Caption position
descPosition.description: Where image title and description appear inside the lightbox.
